Hi Michael -

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through Finex's use case and current constraints. Quick recap from our discovery call: 

- Goal: Serve low-latency inference for customer-facing features while keeping all data and models inside Finex's VPC or on-prem environment.
- Key nonfunctional requirements: PCI-adjacent controls, KMS/HSM for key management, strict egress controls, and audit log retention for 12 months.
- Expected load: ~200 concurrent sessions at peak, median prompt length ~120 tokens, spike patterns during business hours.
- Integration points you mentioned: internal SSO (SAML), existing Prometheus stack for metrics, and an internal firewall managed by the network team.

As discussed, the next step is a 60-minute technical architecture review (Private/VPC or on-prem packaging) with your infra and security leads. This will let our Solutions Engineer map out network requirements, IAM/KMS integration, and deployment topology (single-tenant vs. isolated nodes).

Proposed agenda (we can tweak):
1) 5m - Introductions & goals
2) 10m - High-level architecture and constraints (Finex)
3) 20m - Redwood recommended topology and choices (VPC peering, transit, private link options)
4) 15m - Security controls, KMS/HSM, audit/logging and compliance patterns
5) 10m - Open Q&A and next steps / mutual action items

I attached a draft VPC architecture diagram and a short checklist for the information we'll need ahead of the call. Would you and your security lead be available for one of these slots (PT)?
- Wed Jul 22: 10:00 - 11:00 or 15:00 - 16:00
- Thu Jul 23: 09:00 - 10:00 or 13:00 - 14:00

If none of these work, send a few times that do and we'll accommodate. Also please add your security lead (I saw Emily's name on the discovery notes) - copying Dylan and Dev who will lead the technical discussion from our side.

Attachments: redwood_private_vpc-draft.pdf (diagram), finex_requirements-checklist.xlsx (questionnaire)

Thanks - talk soon.
